tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from three different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A Texas Senate candidate is suing OpenAI, accusing the company's leadership of lying to users and harming Texans. Reported by Yahoo: the lawsuit comes amid broader legal actions against the company at the state level.
Nvidia's RTX 30 graphics processors are getting a major performance boost for artificial intelligence tasks thanks to a new unlock modification. Reported by ThePCEnthusiast: the improvement makes older hardware more capable for modern computing demands.
Anthropic's platform engineering team has shifted entirely to using Claude Code for all coding work. Reported by TechGig: the move represents a full commitment to artificial intelligence tools for their development process.
Free every hour.
